title: Self-direction 4: plan with support

D0.outcome: Explains the plan, do, review cycle and why a review date is part of the plan.

D1.outcome: With a template, writes a four-week plan with one target concept, a weekly load and a review date.

D2.outcome: At the review date, revises the plan from evidence, changing one thing for a stated reason.

D3.outcome: Completes two plan, do, review cycles with the support fading.

misconceptions: A plan with many goals is a better plan.
conditions: The plan names one target and a review date.
contrasts: Ten goals and no load limit.
A plan unchanged despite contrary evidence.
A plan for a skill that is already mastered.
